name: Archicom S.A.
summary: Archicom S.A. operates as a Polish real estate firm with diverse activities. Its business encompasses the development, construction, leasing, and sale of both commercial and residential properties. Additionally, the company is involved in acquiring and divesting real estate assets, managing building development initiatives, leasing intellectual property, and providing financial services. Established in 1986, Archicom S.A. is headquartered in Wroclaw, Poland, and functions as a subsidiary of Echo Investment S.A.
